title: Coefficient-four log^11 loglog^4 construction with a logarithmic-seed strong bootstrap

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. N<128 outputs0; larger inputs have L=ceil(log2 N),z=ceil(log2 L),actual L-bit header S-1. With P2 rounding: h=e=P2(S L^2 z),ell=P2(S^3 L^4 z),eprime=P2(S^5 L^6 z^2),d=P2(S^9 L^6 z^2),Y=P2(S^11 L^9 z^3),k=P2(S^13 L^11 z^4). Initial D11 A1 has precisionceil(L/28)+10,exact rational field and adaptive B1,seedcap5L. Four shared-z internal maps retain t=floor(log2 L),rho=2^t,K128rho*M,raw-table guardK*B>=4rho*s*M; short E1 is direct B2.3. B5 is the fully supplied logarithmic-external-seed bootstrap: r-bit source padded to n=P2(r),w=ceil(log2 r),two1024-wise polynomial bit samplers,ell_s=n//2176000,kappa=ell_s//16000,weak outputM1=kappa//8,weak shared-field seedD1=5*(1000w)^2+2000w,direct A1D4 helper outputP2(D1),errorlog160w+10,and ceil((m-c)/M1) fresh external-seed rounds. Prefix hash degree1000w,lengthc250w supplies shifted agreement. Sampler scalar error and all entropy/helper guards are exact program checks. Entire G is generally nonlinear; only strong general extraction and shifted agreement are used. Layout delta1/125,m=floor(r/125),b=floor(floor(sqrt(S))*w/(30*125^2)),u=2b+2w+10. Initial matrix/field, B5prefix modulus,sampler field and helper A1 data are charged input bits; other internal maps have no data. Every failed plan outputs0,all headers/data are evaluated by one polynomial-time algorithm. A fixed good S0 is only a charged hard restriction. Eventuald0<4L,P<20L and initialbad2N^(-1/28) versus S_groups^delta<=2^((4/125)L) close the bound.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^4. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^(4+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(11+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed ordinary header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P<=20L eventually, hence P=O(L)=o(k). The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2*u) independence and log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

experiments.purpose: Bounded exact checks of the actual evaluator and scalar plans, sampler tree-cap inequalities on finite distributions, limited-independence sampler assignments and collision moments, backward seed packing using mocks, component fixed-seed linearity, shared-multiplier raw-table identities, weak-design conditional expectations, field towers/PV maps, charged header/data offsets, refreshed index mocks, robust-function arithmetic and full-B2 local sharing patterns. Component linearity does not assert linearity of the nonlinear bootstrap map. These finite checks do not establish the universal theorem or instantiate the eventual enormous family.
